_worked_example: ARC STEP. GDD §19.5's third of three, and the arc's closing beat. Frank speaks once, at D-1, which is GDD v2 ch.13's director ruling preserved on top of the press ladder rather than replaced by it. One option, no cost: this is a beat, not a decision, and GDD v2 ch.11 §4's cost law allows a costless option only when the card is explicitly a beat.

_variant_note: GDD v2 ch.09 §3: after seed money a stall reads as failure and running_on_fumes becomes live, so the durgun state colours this warning. A by_seam body does it without a second card: state 0 (no round taken) keeps the sealed line untouched, state 3 (stalled) gets the version that knows money was raised against a promise. States 1 and 2 fall back to the lowest key, which is the sealed line - correct, because a founder who kept the promise should hear the same thing as one who never made it.
